Calibrated chance and edge: the score becomes a calibrated anytime-TD chance. Hard Rock's ATD market is one-sided, so the no-vig chance per game is each implied chance times k, where k = Hard Rock's expected number of different TD scorers divided by the sum of every player's implied chance in that game, capped at 1; no ladder = the median k (0.89). EDGE = calibrated chance minus no-vig chance.
